title: LootLabs Automater
features:
This script will automate Loot Labs monetization links. 
Turn off adblock as it can interfere with the script.
Could be patched at any time cannot guarantee this page will be updated immediately but it will be as soon as I'm aware.

How to use:
Install Tampermonkey/Violentmonkey Chromium Extension
Go to "https://github.com/tomatotxt/bypasses/raw/main/lootlabs.user.js"
Press Install Script (After reviewing code to make sure its safe its open source)

Please leave your thoughts in the comments hateful or helpful.
script:
if print ~= nil then
    print("https://github.com/tomatotxt/bypasses/raw/main/lootlabs.user.js")
    if setclipboard ~= nil then
        setclipboard("https://github.com/tomatotxt/bypasses/raw/main/lootlabs.user.js")
    end
end
